messages:
jamie: deploy-bot preflight flagged prompt-eval regression on summarizer, tagging for decision. pin or rollback?

deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY CHECK: prompt-eval-suite v3.2
canary: 10% traffic
metrics: ROUGE ↓ 2.8%, hallucination ↑ 5.6%
regressions: 12/240 tests exceed threshold
suggestion: HOLD and require triage
logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/preflight/9876

alex: linked. is this only on canary or already in prod? when did rollout start?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started 1759876000 (10% traffic). No prod promotion recorded.

maria: from product POV, +5.6% hallucination is material for summaries. i'd vote pin to last good model while ML triages.

suresh: agree. any quick bisect candidates? maybe a quant flag or kernel swap in 1.2.5-rc?

eva-ml: pulled the eval diffs — regressions concentrate on long-context docs (>1k tokens). looks like a KV cache boundary issue after the new attention kernel. repro snippet:
```
python eval/run_prompt_suite.py --model redwood/summarizer@v1.2.5 --suite long_context
```
failures observed in tests 47, 88, 102.

jamie: change window closes in ~3h. recommendation: pin canary back to v1.2.3 and hold the rollout. who can push the pin?

alex: i can push the pin and update deploybot routing. is this a config-only change? how do we express the pin?

suresh: pin is a routing override — set model_override in service config to redwood/summarizer@v1.2.3 for the canary cluster. no infra deploy required.

ops-oncall: FYI change window is 20:00-23:00 UTC. please complete any production-impacting ops by 22:45 UTC to allow rollback time.

jamie: alex, please do the pin. i'll draft release note text and flag the regression.

alex: on it. pushing pin now. command:
```
releasesctl pin --service=nlp-summarizer --model=redwood/summarizer@v1.2.3 --scope=canary
```
expect routing change in ~90s.

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin submitted by alex at 1759876360
Routing updated: canary cluster now serving redwood/summarizer@v1.2.3 -> 100%
Preflight re-run scheduled.

deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY RE-RUN: prompt-eval-suite v3.2 on canary
metrics: ROUGE Δ 0.0%, hallucination Δ +0.1%
regressions: 1/240 (test 102 residual)
Status: PASS relative to baseline. Recommendation: clear to continue but hold for QA signoff.

maria: QA please confirm the single residual case. if it's low severity we can proceed with prod promotion.

eva-ml: filed ML-482 with reproducer and an initial patch idea (KV boundary guard). hotfix PR incoming; ETA ~4h.

jamie: decision: pin on canary and block promotion to prod until hotfix or explicit approval. open PR for hotfix and schedule follow-up after tests. i'll add note to release notes.

alex: done. pinned and annotated release: "Temporary pin to v1.2.3 due to long-context regressions; hotfix PR ML-482 in progress."

suresh: :thumbsup: i'll take the bisect and run the local reproducer.

ops-oncall: recording incident window. if hotfix merges, plan promotion at next change window Mon 21:00 UTC unless urgent rollback required.

jamie: thanks all — closing thread. keep updates in ML-482 and reopen here if anything changes.
